messages:
maria: evening passoff — I'm primary for the next 8h :wave: quick run through of coverage and perms before I go offline at 23:00 UTC

maria: Current customer-impacting alerts: None open on PD, but we had two noisy 5xx spikes on inference-api earlier, mitigated by autoscaling. Logged in the incident tracker.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: no active incidents for service: inference-api. Weekly alert summary attached.

jordan: thanks. Are you handing off Grafana access to the night anchor? I noticed some dashboards still require the "infra-sre-view" group.

maria: yep, @kevin will be secondary tonight. Kevin — can you confirm you have dashboard access + ability to create temporary snapshots? also check AWS read permissions for logs.

kevin: I can view most dashboards but the latency-summary dashboard shows 403 for me when I try to open the rollout panel :eyes:

maria: ahh that's likely the new dashboard beta. Try this fix first: add yourself to grafana-readonly in Okta or use the adhoc link. If that fails we can escalate to eng-security.

kevin: trying now. if anyone needs it, grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/inference/latency-summary

alec: FYI — if you need to request temp access, runbook has the fast request step (creates ticket to eng-security with "oncall-temp-access" tag). Link: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/oncall/access-requests

maria: checklist before I leave:
1) PD escalation policy set to "night-ops" for inference-api
2) Primary + secondary listed in PD schedule (verify)
3) AWS console: CloudWatch logs and CloudTrail read for the night anchor
4) Grafana dashboards + snapshot permissions
5) Runbook link pinned to thread

jordan: on PD schedule — I see primary shows as "maria" and secondary "kevin" in the schedule UI. PD schedule: https://pd.redwood.io/schedules/inference

kevin: update — Okta add fixed the 403, I can access the rollout panel and create a snapshot. :thumbsup:

maria: great. For AWS perms, quick test command to verify s3 and logs access (run in your own terminal):
```
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-inference-logs --profile oncall
aws logs describe-log-groups --profile oncall | grep inference
```

kevin: ran both — s3 list works, logs list good. I don't have delete perms which is fine.

maria: perfect. One more: check ability to read pod logs for model-serving in kube:
```
kubectl --context prod get pods -n inference
kubectl --context prod logs -n inference <pod-name> -c model-server --tail 200
```

alec: if you hit RBAC errors for kubectl, open a ticket with infra-platform and include the exact error message, they usually grant temporary view role within 15-30 mins.

kevin: kubectl logs worked for me.

maria: note on customer impact — the spike earlier affected 3% of requests, mostly tail-latency on models >16k tokens. We rolled back to a lower batch size which reduced error rate. I logged the eval details in the incident tracker: https://incidents.redwood/internal/INC-2026-042

jordan: thanks for logging. If the spike recurs, escalate to paging policy P1 if error rate >5% for >10m. That's in runbook.

maria: runbook pointers I want the night anchor to have:
- Production mitigation: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/inference/mitigation
- PD playbook for noisy 5xx: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/pd/noisy-5xx
- Rollback and model-pin steps: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/deploy/rollback

incident-bot: Reminder: attach a short post-shift note in #incidents if any follow-ups are needed.

kevin: will do. One open item: I don't have access to the quantization config buckets (s3://redwood-model-configs). If we need to change quant profiles at night, I'll need a temp grant.

maria: noted — if you need that, open a temp-perms ticket with `oncall-temp-access` and tag me. For anything urgent open a PD incident and set escalation to eng-ml.

jordan: also double-check that DB read-only role is working for the usage-summaries. Query example:
```
psql -h redwood-db.prod -U readonly -c "select count(*) from inference_requests where timestamp > now() - interval '1 hour';"
```

kevin: DB read works.

maria: ok final confirmations:
- Primary: maria (confirmed)
- Secondary: kevin (confirmed)
- Coverage gaps: none known, APAC swing covered by oncall rotation tomorrow morning
- Runbook links posted above
- PD escalation policy verified

kevin: I acknowledge, I'm on call. :heavy_check_mark:

alec: acknowledged. logging handoff in PagerDuty notes.

maria: leaving the bridge to you both. If anything spikes, page me as well. Thanks, night team :coffee:
